_readme: Generated from the provided Google Sheet (product wishlist, no per-item pricing present in source).

categoryName/unitName are human-readable names, NOT database IDs - resolve to Category.id/Unit.id by name at import time (create the category if it doesn't exist yet; all unitName values already exist in the seed data).
costPrice and sellingPrice are placeholder 0 (in cents) for every product - MUST be filled in with real values before these products are usable at checkout.

needsReview=true flags items where the source text was ambiguous, a typo'd brand guess, or a bundled variant split without explicit source labels - double-check the name/identity before relying on it.
sku is NOT included - it is generated server-side (PRD-000001 format) by SkuService on creation.
currentStock is NOT included - stock is only ever set via a StockMovement; use initialStock instead, which the product-creation flow records as an initial IN movement.

excludedFromSheet.reason: placeholder note left by sheet author, not an actual product name
